name: place_tube
description: A tapering tube swept through a path of points — THE primitive for dragon necks, bodies, and tails. Radius interpolates along the path, so pass r_start > r_end to taper. Give 3+ points for a curve.

path.description: Spine points. The tube is swept through them.

material.description: One of 100 materials. Call list_materials to see them all.
